**1. Hero Full Bleed (`site/snippets/blocks/split-hero.php`):**
I forced the top-level section container to break out of any constraints using the `w-screen relative left-1/2 right-1/2 -mx-[50vw]` strategy to ensure the video background is fully bled to the viewport edges. I also added `overflow-hidden` to clip cleanly.

**2. Bento Grid (`site/snippets/blocks/bento-grid.php`):**
- I strictly applied `grid-auto-rows: 240px !important;` to the internal style block.
- I stripped the CSS variable dependency for gaps and hardcoded Tailwind utility classes directly on the container: `gap-4 md:gap-6 p-4 md:p-6`.
- I enforced `border-radius: 0 !important;` directly on `.bento-item` instead of relying on the variable, completely eliminating rounded corners.

**3. Bento Media Item (`site/snippets/blocks/bento-items/bento-media.php`):**
I hardened the image wrapper and the `img` tags to include `absolute inset-0 w-full h-full object-cover m-0 p-0` on both elements to guarantee they fully populate the strict cell geometry without any chance of clipping or overflow altering row height.
